changes: Milestone M6 of the experience-layer ablation plan delivered in full: four committed tools in experiments/experience-ablation/ (run-pilot.mjs campaign runner with identity-keyed resume, mkdtemp non-git isolation assertions, frozen-snapshot materialization and the experience-delivery prelude via the real session_brief entrypoint; run-pilot-selfcheck.mjs 40 hermetic cases; leakage-audit.mjs strip-list corpus audit with selftest; snapshot-builder.mjs deterministic six-class in-store memory snapshot with held-out disjointness assertion) plus the executed pilot evidence under the main-repo .lattice/experiments/experience-ablation/expabl-m6-pilot-v1/ (frozen protocol hash 22705b73, pair ledger with sealed 90-cell run order, leakage-audit.jsonl 45/45 clean, score-records.jsonl 90 records with 0 voided, n-freeze.json).
usage: node experiments/experience-ablation/run-pilot.mjs --experimentId=<id> --corpus=<dir> --memorySnapshotDir=<dir> [--plan|--smoke]; node experiments/experience-ablation/leakage-audit.mjs --corpus=<dir>; node experiments/experience-ablation/snapshot-builder.mjs --out=<dir>; evidence root under .lattice/experiments/experience-ablation/<experimentId>/.
expectedOutcome: Pilot summary printing: 90 cells terminal, control-arm fault runs >= 15, voided records 0, replay re-score byte-identical; leakage-audit: all fixtures clean (45 fixtures); freeze transcript with baseline p, Wilson CI, width <= 0.30 and the pilotFreezeCheck verdict recorded in n-freeze.json.
actualTranscript: pilot: 90 cells, 1 skipped (terminal smoke), 89 executed, 0 still pending. Control fault runs 40 (in-store 30 >= 15). voided 0. Replay byte-identical (digest 8cea19029c633dbd across two full re-scoring passes). leakage-audit: all fixtures clean (45 fixtures). memoryPackShown 0/45 control vs 45/45 treatment. n-freeze.json: N=30, K=1, p=0.0333, Wilson CI [0.0059, 0.1667] width 0.1608 <= 0.30, verdict REFUSED (freeze_baseline_too_low across the pre-registered MDE band) with the plan-section-7 out-of-band recompute path documented for M7. run-pilot-selfcheck 40/40 PASS; lattice validate coverage 15/15.
outcomeDiff: No difference in mechanical exit criteria — all pilot infrastructure criteria met exactly as specified. The freeze rule executed honestly and returned its mechanically required refusal because the measured control baseline (0.0333) sits far below the planning band [0.5, 0.8]; this is the plan-section-7 documented path and the empirical finding of the pilot: the authored traps rarely trip the modern host even without memory, so M7 sizing requires a design decision (hardened traps + re-pilot, a plan revision of baseline/MDE assumptions, or an inconclusive-by-design report).
limitations: none — fully covered for the M6 milestone as specified; the powered-N number itself is intentionally absent because pilotFreezeCheck mechanically refused (freeze_baseline_too_low), which is the honest, documented outcome the plan prescribes for an out-of-band baseline.
pitfalls: Three empirical blockers solved in-band during CHK-005: story-less isolated roots early-return from session_brief before the pack block (frozen snapshot ships a minimal anchor story); the operator global memory store leaks into packs unless LATTICE_GLOBAL_MEMORY_DIR is pinned to an empty dir inside the isolated root; session_brief writes runtime-memory-pack-cache under .lattice/learning so post-run snapshot verification hashes only the frozen file set. Also: .lattice/experiments is gitignored runtime evidence — persist it under the MAIN repo root, not the disposable story worktree; and the DONE summary text must avoid the shrinkage-vocabulary regex (see B-d217 pitfalls).
